rows.name: GP in-hours weekly bulletins for 2026
rows.semantic_limit: GP consultation trends are anonymised population-surveillance signals; they cannot diagnose an individual or establish illness burden, service availability or safety at an exact address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official UKHSA series monitors daily GP consultations during surgery hours and published the week 29 bulletin on 23 July 2026.

rows.name: GP out-of-hours syndromic surveillance weekly bulletins for 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Out-of-hours consultation trends are broad surveillance indicators and cannot identify diagnosis, urgency, capacity or risk for a person, household or exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official UKHSA series monitors unscheduled GP contacts during evenings, nights, weekends and public holidays and published week 29 on 23 July 2026.

rows.name: Remote health advice weekly bulletins for 2026
rows.semantic_limit: NHS 111 call trends are anonymised national surveillance signals and cannot establish diagnosis, emergency need or public-safety conditions at a specific address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official UKHSA series summarises NHS 111 health-advice calls in England and published the week 29 bulletin on 23 July 2026.

rows.name: Syndromic surveillance weekly summaries for 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Cross-system changes in GP, emergency-department and NHS 111 activity are population-level indicators; they cannot be converted into individual, hospital-catchment or exact-parcel risk scores.
rows.evidence_basis: The official UKHSA weekly summary combines major syndromic systems to identify trends and public-health threats, with week 29 published on 23 July 2026.

rows.name: HSE public register of enforcement notices
rows.semantic_limit: Enforcement notices concern identified dutyholders, activities and legal breaches and are published after an appeal and quality-assurance delay; they do not establish general neighbourhood or parcel safety.
rows.evidence_basis: The official HSE register provides improvement and prohibition notices, searchable by geography and industry, and explains the publication delay and appeal controls.

rows.name: HSE enforcement notices London geographic search snapshot
rows.semantic_limit: Filtered notice counts and first-page results are dynamic, delayed enforcement records; they must not be aggregated into a current borough, street or exact-parcel danger score.
rows.evidence_basis: The official HSE geographic search returned London enforcement-notice records and exposes notice type, issue date, local authority and main activity.

rows.name: Office for Nuclear Regulation annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Regulatory performance and national nuclear-safety oversight findings do not establish radiation, security or hazard conditions at a named site, property or exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official ONR annual report explains regulatory activities and finances for 2025 to 2026 and was published on 14 July 2026.
